goal: Ship a new research-algorithms tool with a real-data finding
notes: Explore idea: probability calibration as a research-algorithm tool (ventures/probability-calibration). Contents: the CORP reliability diagram (Dimitriadis, Gneiting & Jordan 2021) with PAV isotonic fit and a resampling consistency band; the exact MCB-DSC+UNC split for Brier and log scores; a Monte Carlo test using MCB as its statistic (this tool's addition); the observed/expected count; Spiegelhalter z; Cox slope and intercept; binned ECE and Murphy split; AUC; isotonic and Platt recalibration; CLI and agent call. Verified against scikit-learn 1.9.1 / scipy 1.18.1 / numpy 2.5.3 (eval/reference.py), to 1e-10 or 1e-6 for the logistic fit; 8 DOIs checked against Crossref. Finding on FiveThirtyEight NFL Elo 2010-2020 (2,930 games): the shape test passes (p=0.289) but home wins fall short overall, 56.5% vs 58.4% forecast (z=-2.24, p=0.025), mostly 2019 (52.3 vs 58.8) and 2020 (50.0 vs 58.5); through 2019 not significant (p=0.16). ECE ranges 0.019-0.043 across bin choices on the same data. Rendered in Chromium at 1100 and 390 px widths: no console errors, no overflow. Venture tests: probability-calibration 34, conformal-prediction-intervals 46, inter-rater-agreement 39, all pass.
